title: Sure Thing Fishing

services.name: Charter Info
services.desc: Sportfishing ( 1 - 8 persons ) $260/hr Additional Guests $125/person Harbour Cruises / Midnight Cruises ( up to 12 persons ) $300/hr All bookings are done in advance and must be confirmed with a $200 deposit (refundable in the event of inclement weather). Last minute bookings are available but some restrictions may apply. Departures are generally from Scarborough’s Bluffers Park Marina, but arrangements can be made for departures from other locations. Scheduled departure / arrival times are as follows: Sportfishing-Half Day* 6:00 am - 11:00 am or 3:00 pm - 8:00 pm (alternate/custom departure times available) Sportfishing-Full Day* 6:00 am - 7:00 pm Harbour Cruises 2:00 pm - 6:00 pm or 7:00

blurb: We regularly compete in many of the professional fishing tournaments, and have hosted many television fishing shows featuring Lake Ontario Sportfishing, including Fish TV, Fish’n Canada, Angler & Hunter Television and the Ultimate Fishing Show. We are excited to have you on-board and let Sure-Thing Sportfishing guide you and your guests
